claims: NASA officially targets early 2028 for the Artemis IV crewed lunar landing mission.
Some estimates cite September 2028 for the Artemis IV crewed lunar landing mission.
Artemis IV will utilize the Space Launch System (SLS) Block 1B rocket.
Artemis IV will deliver the International Habitation Module (I-Hab) to the Lunar Gateway.
Artemis IV will transport astronauts to the lunar surface.
Artemis IV is the second crewed lunar landing of the program after Artemis III.
Artemis IV's launch vehicle is SLS Block 1B.
Artemis IV's target date is early to September 2028.
Artemis IV's location is Lunar South Pole.
The Artemis IV timeline remains subject to the success and scheduling of the preceding Artemis II and Artemis III missions.
